selected_evidence.requirement: Record sudo commands with user and timestamp in /var/log/sudo-commands.log
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the valid installed policy, secure dedicated logfile, and a live entry containing timestamp, invoking user, target user, working directory, and command.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep sudo command entries out of the general system log
selected_evidence.summary: The policy disables sudo syslog emission; unique pre- and post-reboot probes had zero matches in /var/log/syslog, /var/log/auth.log, and the journal.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic are identical before and after the change and reboot.

Captures healthy pre-reboot state and acknowledgement, changed boot ID from 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45 to 9b4aab42-d91f-440b-9b34-2fdcd56d0463, active rsyslog, valid persistent policy, retained audit data, and successful post-reboot logging isolation.
